title: 01 — The Problem
desc: Standard weather apps are cluttered with ads, slow to load, lack offline support, and provide no real-time geolocation precision. Users needed a premium, installable PWA experience.

title: 02 — My Role
desc: Lead Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer — Managed PWA architecture, OpenWeather API integration, Chart.js data visualization, AI summary generation, and Framer Motion animations.

title: 03 — The Solution
desc: Built SkyPulse PRO as a Next.js PWA with OpenWeather API, real-time geolocation, 24-hour Chart.js forecasts, adaptive glassmorphism themes, and an integrated AI weather assistant.

title: 04 — Key Features
desc: Real-time weather tracking, 7-day forecasts, AQI metrics, PWA installability, AI-powered daily summaries, and interactive Chart.js weather visualization.

title: 05 — Tech Stack
desc: Modern frontend-focused stack chosen for PWA performance, smooth animations, and zero-backend real-time data delivery.

title: 06 — Technical Hurdles
desc: Managed geolocation permission fallbacks, implemented service worker caching for offline mode, and optimized Chart.js renders to prevent layout reflow on mobile.

title: 07 — Measurable Result
desc: Achieved 98+ Lighthouse performance score, sub-second page loads, native PWA installation on iOS and Android, and 100% mobile-responsive layout.

title: 08 — Live Applications
desc: Explore the open-source GitHub repository, inspect technical architecture, or test live production web applications.
